Entries.Text: FX Reloader
The FX Reloader works with Dark Souls III, Sekiro, Elden Ring, Armored Core VI and Elden Ring Nightreign.
Connect to the running game to reload the selected effect from this editor's copy and list the effects the game has loaded. The game must run offline with EAC disabled.

Auto Refresh

every %.1f s

How often to read the game while this tool is shown, from {0} to {1} seconds. Shorter intervals catch brief effects in Recently Detected, but each read walks the game's whole effect list (about 9,000 effects), so very short intervals use more CPU. The last read took {2} ms. Restart weapon and SpEffect effects after a reload

After a reload, effects played by weapons (buffs, infusions) and SpEffects (auras, status effects) are briefly switched off and on in the game's params, so the game spawns them again with the reloaded version. The project's params aren't changed. Skipped when the world is reloaded afterwards.
